name: It Is Time, Brother...
summary: A missive must reach Krom'rosh at Rog'mar as the danger grows. Da'grosh's warning recalls an old hope for the village and the Horde.

sections.title: A Warning for Rog'mar
sections.body: The threat has grown beyond what was first thought, and Rog'mar needs warning. You carry a missive to Krom'rosh, with no time to stop for anyone along the way.

sections.title: An Old Hope
sections.body: Da'grosh once urged the village's kin to become great warriors of the Horde and protect their people from danger. Krom'rosh now sees a chance for that hope to be tested.

faq.answer: Rog'mar must be warned because the threat is greater than first thought.
Krom'rosh at Rog'mar receives the missive.

faq.q: Why can't I stop along the way?
faq.answer: The missive must reach Krom'rosh, and the warning says not to stop for anyone on the path.

faq.q: What did Da'grosh tell the village as a child?
faq.answer: Da'grosh urged the village's kin to become great warriors of the Horde and save their people from danger.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you hear Da'grosh's childhood hope that the village's kin might become warriors who save their people.
As a warrior, you are named in Da'grosh's hope for the village's kin to become great warriors of the Horde.

attribution: In-game quest text: It Is Time, Brother...
